telegram.header: WESTERN UNION · NIGHT LETTER · 17 NOV 1933 · 4.52 PM
lines: THE TRUTH ABOUT THE MARIGOLD STOP
telegram.vo: Inspector Hart. Come to Sable Flat. The truth about the Marigold. Tell no one. C. Pryce.

title: THE MARIGOLD SILENCE

coleSky.speaker: Danny Cole
coleSky.text: Chief, I can't see the ground.

hartSky.speaker: Hart
hartSky.text: Neither can the ground see us.

hobbs.speaker: Walter Hobbs
hobbs.text: Mr. Pryce said you'd come. He didn't say the storm would, too.

pryce.speaker: Cornelius Pryce
pryce.text: To Marigold. May she forgive me.

captions.sky: Somewhere over the Nevada desert. Friday, late afternoon.

closeups.note: a smile that doesn't reach her eyes
